name: Menu
summary: A vertical list of selectable options — a side nav, settings list, or overflow menu.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-menu> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; feed it an `items` JSON array and a `value` (the selected key). The selected row is brand-tinted; hover and selection animate via the shared motion tokens on PERSISTENT nodes — selection toggles a class, it never rebuilds the row. Emits a composed `select` event.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `select`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Container
spec.value: white surface, 1px border #E3E3E3, radius 8, 6 padding, min-width 200

props.name: items
props.desc: The rows; each needs a key + label, optional disabled

props.name: select
props.desc: Composed event on selection, detail { key }

whenToUse.when: a vertical list of destinations or options — a side nav, a settings list, an overflow list
switching horizontal views within one screen
the same list should sit inside a triggered overlay, not inline

opinion.note: One selection at a time — reserve the brand tint for the active row. Keep labels short and in sentence case. For a triggered overlay, put a Menu inside a Dropdown rather than reinventing the list.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Menu cell; spec derived from the token layer (white surface, border #E3E3E3, bg-accent selected fill, color-primary label, radius-default 8) + AntD Menu conventions (vertical rows, single selection, disabled rows). Motion bound to the shared motion tokens on persistent nodes.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

selfCheck.label: hover animates on a persistent node (not a rebuild)

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.
